Grapeseed Carrier Oil

Vitis vinifera

The lightest carrier we stock, and the fastest to absorb.

Very light and almost dry on the skin, which makes it the usual choice for anyone who finds other carriers heavy. A by-product of winemaking, pressed from the seeds left after the fruit is crushed.

How to use

  • Use as a facial oil base if jojoba feels too rich.
  • Good for massage, where it spreads easily and absorbs fast.
  • Keep refrigerated — it turns faster than most carriers.

Dilute before applying to skin and patch-test first. Not for internal use.

Scent profile

  • Almost odourless
  • Very light
  • Dry finish

What's in it

  • 100% cold-pressed Vitis vinifera seed oil

Who it's for

Oily or combination skin

The lightest carrier we stock and the one least likely to feel like a layer.

Massage

Spreads easily, absorbs fast, and is inexpensive enough to use generously.

Hot and humid weather

Where jojoba and almond start to feel heavy, this does not.

What people get wrong

Keeping it in a warm bathroom. It is high in polyunsaturated fats and turns faster than any carrier we sell. Refrigerate it and use it within about six months.

Expecting it to be nourishing in the way heavier carriers are. It is light precisely because it is low in the richer fats, which is a trade-off rather than a free win.

What it won't do

A carrier, not an essential oil — no aroma, nothing to diffuse. And it has the shortest shelf life of anything in our range.

We describe how our oils smell and how people use them. We don't make medical claims, because essential oils aren't medicine.

Questions about Grapeseed Carrier Oil

How long does it last?

About six months from opening, refrigerated. It is high in polyunsaturated fats, which oxidise quickly. If it smells sharp or like old crayons, it has turned.

Is it better than jojoba for the face?

Different rather than better. Grapeseed is lighter and absorbs faster; jojoba is more stable and closer to skin's own sebum. People with oily skin often prefer grapeseed, but it will not keep as long.

How long does it keep once opened?

Around a year for a cold-pressed oil like this one — less in a warm bathroom. Keep the cap tight and store it somewhere cool and dark. If it starts to smell like old crayons, it has turned and should not go on skin.

Do I need to dilute it?

No — this is the carrier. It goes on neat, or it is what you dilute essential oils into. For a 2% blend, add about 12 drops of essential oil per 30 ml.

How quickly will it arrive?

Orders are dispatched from Delhi within two business days and usually arrive within a further three to five, depending on where you are. Shipping is free over ₹999.
